name: Dungeon of Departure
storyline:
Dungeon of Departure is an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe. The story follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

Choices matter as your decisions can lead you through four unique story paths. Plus, throughout the journey, your team will be relying on your way-finding and map-making abilities, which will determine the success or failure of these paths, resulting in eight unique endings.
summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.
